title: Packet Decoder
description: Parse nested BITS protocol packets to sum versions and evaluate expressions.
writeup:
## Approach

The hex input encodes a binary stream of nested packets. Each packet has a 3-bit version, a 3-bit type ID, and either a literal value (type 4) or sub-packets (all other types). A recursive parser naturally mirrors this tree structure.

## Part 1

Recursively parse the entire packet tree, accumulating the version number from every packet encountered. The answer is the total version sum.

## Part 2

During the same recursive parse, evaluate each packet as an expression. Operator types map to `sum`, `product`, `min`, `max`, `>`, `<`, and `==`. Literal packets are leaf values. The outermost packet's evaluated result is the answer.
